paite: Himahleh huai in Jonah alungkim het kei a, ahehta hi.
heading: Pathian Itna Leh Jonah Hehna

paite: TOUPA kiang ah athum a, “Aw TOUPA, ka hon ngen ahi, hiai ka gam ua ka om lai a ka gen hilou hia? Hiai ziak in Tarshish lam ah ka taimang pah a; hehpih thei Pathian, lainatna a dim, heh mengmeng lou, zahngaihna hau, thil hoih lou lehngatsan sek na hi chih ka thei hi.
Huaiziak in AW TOUPA, tu in ka hinna hon laksak ding in ka hon ngen hi; kei a ding in hin sang in sih ahoihzaw hi,” achi hi.
Huan TOUPA'N, na heh mawk, na hihdik hia? achi hi.
Huchi in khopi a kipan Jonah apaikhia a, khopi suahlam pang ah atu a, huai ah sawlbuk alam a, khopi tung a thil hong tung ding muh tum in anuailim ah atu nilouh hi.
Toupa PATHIAN in umgui Jonah tung ah azamsak a, ahaksatna a kipan hunkhe ding a alu liah ding in ana sepkhol hi. Huchi in Jonah umgui ziak in akipak mahmah hi.
heading: Umgui A Kipan Sinlai

paite: Himahleh Pathian in, azingsang phalvak in, leikha ana sepkhol a, huai in umgui akeitan a, ahong vuaita hi.
Huan hichi ahong hi a, ni ahong suah in Pathian in suahlam huih ana sepkhol a; ni in Jonah lu ahai a, asibup a, amah a ding in sih angen hi, “Kei a ding in hin sang in sih ahoihzaw," achi hi.
Pathian in Jonah kiang ah, “Umgui tungtang thu a na heh mawk, na hihdik hia?" achi hi. Ama'n, "Sih ut hial a ka heh, ka hihdik hi,” achi hi.
TOUPA'N, “Na gim pih louh, na khansak leng hi sam lou, zan khat thu a hong om a, zan khat thu a mang nawn umgui na hehpihleh;
Nineveh khua, khopi thupitak, asung a mi nuaikhat-le-singnih sang a tam, ataklam uleh aveilam uh leng khen theiloute leh ganhon tampi omna, ka hehpih kei dia hia?" achi hi.
